verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no region or residency selection for Trigger.dev Cloud. The only path is the product's own self-hosting option, which lets you run the platform on your own infrastructure and so implicitly decide where data lives. The docs never explicitly frame this as data storage location or residency. Missing for 10: region or residency selection on Trigger.dev Cloud, explicit documentation of where data is stored, residency guarantees or compliance statements, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosting Trigger.dev means you run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your environment
